descriptions.value: A vulnerability in the command line interface of AOS-8 could allow an authenticated remote attacker with high privileges to conduct a server-side request forgery (SSRF) attack. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system.

assertions.title: Authenticated Server-Side Request Forgery leads to Remote Code Execution in AOS-8

title: Authenticated Server-Side Request Forgery leads to Remote Code Execution in AOS-8
